reason: Most of what I buy is cables, phone accessories and small car bits, and 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item is two-thirds on top. By the time it lands, the shops on Rasheed Street or another Instagram page usually have it close enough and I don't wait three weeks.
objection: Shipping per kilo makes small cheap items not worth it, and I don't know if they round a 200 gram item up to a full kilo. Plus it's a new name, I'd rather stick with the agent I already know.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me combine several small items into one shipment and charging by actual grams, so a batch of accessories costs me under about 12,000 in fees total.
